analysis.reasonEn: 3 consecutive sessions of wait-and-see read maintained. RSI is sideways in the neutral zone after exiting oversold, and MACD histogram is improving in negative territory but too early to confirm trend change. ADX at 19.1 indicates no trend formation, and volume ratio of 0.67 shows contracted volume, lowering confidence in price movement. At 5.3% of 52-week range, sideways consolidation continues near the low.

· RSI 궤적 (59.3→47.5) + 과매도 구간 탈출 후 중립 구간 횡보 + 하락 방향성

[거래량·결론]
· 거래량 비율 (0.67배) + 움직임의 신뢰도 위축
· 현 구간 진단 (축적구간) + 관망 조건: RSI 50 이상 회복 및 거래량 증가 확인
analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price($0.18) vs SMA5/20/50($0.18/$0.18/$0.18) — positioned near short/mid-term trend mid-line
· Below SMA100/200($0.19/$0.23) — indicating weak long-term trend strength
· 52-week position (5.3%) + consolidating near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (59.3→47.5) + exiting oversold, now in neutral range with downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (0.0019→-0.0018) + improving, but trend reversal signal unconfirmed
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $0.18) + interpreting 29.40% band width
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($0.16) + based on Pivot S1, 20-day low
· Swing resistance ($0.18) + requires confirmation of mid-band hold on breakout
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower High / Lower Low) + interpreting sideways trend
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.67x) + indicating low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and increased volume confirmation
